_meta_itemized.wave: itemized-vision(claude-opus-5; 2026-08-14 summit scan tranche, Phase B)

contributions.detail: exact against BOTH printed gates and with no structural split50 residual, because this filer itemized every gift including the sub-$50 one. The split is applied PER DONOR rather than per row, which is a source property worth naming: six individual rows are under $50 (45.64, 48.08, 29.95, 13.17, 47.88, 29.95) yet all six are counted inside the '>$50' box, because their donor - the candidate himself - aggregates to 2,088.92 over the cycle. A per-ROW reading of the box would give 1,874.25 and would NOT close; the per-DONOR reading closes to the cent, so that is what the form means here. The whole ledger is self-funding plus one 10.17 gift from Marla Howard

expenditures.detail: SIGN-ONLY delta, and it is the FILER's, not this transcription's. The schedule's own printed box reads a POSITIVE '$2,099.09' and the 14 rows reproduce it to the cent; the COVER prints the same figure NEGATIVE ('-$2,099.09' in both the Current Report and Cumulative Totals cells), which is the retained filer-arithmetic property already documented in the module CLAUDE.md ('Howard's 2014 expenditures are printed negative'). Nothing is repaired in either direction: the module's stated figure keeps its minus sign and the itemized sum keeps the schedule's sign. Magnitude reconciles exactly. Note also that this filing's contribution and expenditure ledgers are the SAME 14 amounts in the same order - the candidate reimbursed himself for every purchase, so each expense has a mirror-image contribution row; that is why the cover's campaign balance is 0.00

_meta_itemized.notes: Typed sheet, both ledger pages read full-page at 200 dpi. NO specimen rows survive - the filer overwrote the template's example lines. THREE source properties. (1) THE $50 SPLIT IS APPLIED PER DONOR, NOT PER ROW (see the contributions recon detail) - the arithmetic proves it, and it is the opposite of what a row-wise reading of a split50 sheet would assume. (2) THE CONTRIBUTION LEDGER CARRIES ITS OWN BOTTOM-LINE TOTAL ($2,099.09) printed in the Amount column of the last grid row, six blank rows below the data - a third printed gate the contract's 'two boxed totals' description does not mention; it agrees with the sum of the two boxes and with the transcription. (3) THE MAILING ADDRESS COLUMN HOLDS A STREET ONLY - '9071 N. Jeremy Circle' with a separate Zipcode cell and NO city column - so donor_city / donor_state are honestly BLANK on every row: LEFT INCOMPLETE BY THE FILER, not redacted by the county, and a city is NEVER inferred from the 84098 zip. The street itself was discarded at read time per the privacy contract and appears nowhere in this record. Geometry is MEASURED on both pages (22 and 35 detected bands, regular ~2.0% pitch); spot-verified end-to-end on p2 band 10 (10/1/14 Michael Howard / $29.95) and p3 band 6 (Signs on the cheap / $451.26), both crops reproducing name and amount. Note for anyone reading the pair: the same filer's 2018 filings are in this module, and the county published NOTHING for his 2022 County Auditor run (an existing documented gap) - nothing here bears on that.
